messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=inference-gateway (eu-west1)

pagerduty-bot: PD-INC #45678 triggered — auto-page to oncall rotation. Priority: P1. Link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/45678

zoe: acked — I'm on it. pinging eng-sre and eng-runtime.

leo: oncall-eng here — saw the alert. quick note: canary rollout to model v2.3 started ~8m ago in eu-west1.

maya: looking at metrics — 5xx error-rate jumped from ~0.2% -> 8% over the last 5m. tail shows mostly 502/503 from kv-cache layer.

leo: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T02:12:21Z inference-gateway eu-west1 request_id=abc123 upstream=kv-cache code=502 "KV miss and timeout"
2026-03-15T02:12:22Z inference-gateway eu-west1 request_id=abc124 upstream=model-server code=200 "ok"
2026-03-15T02:12:25Z inference-gateway eu-west1 request_id=abc125 upstream=kv-cache code=503 "connection reset by peer"
```

zoe: initial hypothesis: the canary increased prefix cache pressure -> kv-cache eviction/connection thrash -> upstream 5xx. need to confirm whether it's kv side or network.

maya: checking k6 traces and k8s events — I see rapid pod restarts on kv-cache nodes in eu-west1 zone-b. suspect an out-of-memory or kernel OOM kill.

leo: can we push a quick mitigation: route traffic for eu-west1 to fallback model-variant (v2.2-quant) + increase kv-cache replicas to stabilize?

zoe: agree. I'm going to add a temporary routing rule and scale the kv-cache statefulset. executing:
```
# route-weight update
redwoodctl routes set-weight --route inference-gateway --region eu-west1 --variant v2.2-quant=100

# scale kv-cache
kubectl -n infra scale statefulset/kv-cache --replicas=5 -l region=eu-west1
```

pagerduty-bot: Note: route change will cause brief switch-over; customers may see a short latency bump. PD note attached.

tilly: any confirmed customer impact? CS is getting alerts.

hari: CS update: two enterprise customers (acme-corp, betaapps) reported elevated 502s around 02:13-02:20 UTC. volume small (a few dozen requests) but visible in synthetic checks. No broad pager yet.

zoe: thanks. prioritize fixing infra first. leo — can you warm model cache after route swap? prewarm top prefixes for common prompts.

leo: on it. running warmup script against v2.2-quant:
```
for p in "summarize" "qa" "embed"; do
  curl -s -X POST https://eu-west1.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"warmup: $p","model":"v2.2-quant"}' &
done
```

maya: kv-cache pods scaling now. adding node pressure check and temporary podAntiAffinity removal to allow quick scheduling.

zoe: monitoring metrics: error-rate dropping — 8% -> 1.1% in last 2m. latency +40ms during switch. that's acceptable for now.

pagerduty-bot: Incident status: acknowledged. Auto-suppression applied to downstream noisy alerts for 10m.

tilly: I'll inform ops leaders and create a short incident task for postmortem. @hari can you collect customers' exact timestamps and logs?

hari: will do. uploading CS notes to the incident doc: https://docs.redwood/example/incidents/45678

leo: putting a quick guard in routing policy to prevent canary from exceeding 5% traffic per zone until we complete followup.

zoe: decision log for now: rollback canary withheld. fallback variant routing + kv-cache scale + cache-warm completed. monitoring for 20m, then decide canary reattempt or rollback.

maya: scheduling handoff — I'm taking the next 2hr oncall window to watch metrics and follow up on pod OOM traces. handoff message:
- context: 5xx spike in eu-west1 after model v2.3 canary
- actions taken: routing -> v2.2-quant, scaled kv-cache, warmed cache
- next steps: collect kv-cache pod OOM logs, verify scheduling pressure, check node memory metrics, coordinate with infra for kernel tuning if needed

zoe: thanks @maya — handing off. I'll open the post-incident ticket and assign owners for infra and runtime. please keep this thread updated.

maya: ack — taking over. ping me @maya if anything flares back.

zoe: closing PD-INC #45678 (manual handoff to second oncall). Leaving incident open internally for RCA. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: PD-INC #45678 status changed to acknowledged -> maintenance_hand_off by zoe

maya: quick note for RCA: capture pod OOM events, `dmesg` on affected nodes, and the canary traffic profile. I'll attach cluster snapshots to the ticket.
